subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should yielded cron parents become a permanent public `deferred` status with the proposed Gateway, CLI, UI, persisted-state, hook, and Plugin SDK semantics?
rationale: The underlying bug is real, but choosing a new persisted and public status contract—including CLI non-zero exit behavior and plugin hook metadata—is a compatibility and product decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Approve additive deferred contract
options.body: Accept `deferred` as the canonical yielded-parent handoff state after a clean rebase and exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, delivery, and Discord proof.

options.title: Keep deferral internal
options.body: Preserve the yielded-parent runtime behavior but continue exposing an existing public status, avoiding a new protocol and Plugin SDK contract at the cost of less precise observability.

options.title: Narrow and split the PR
options.body: Land the core cron/subagent lifecycle repair separately and defer Discord progress plus public API expansion to focused follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Approve additive deferred contract
recommendation.body: Accept `deferred` as the canonical yielded-parent handoff state after a clean rebase and exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, delivery, and Discord proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans public protocol, persistence, CLI, UI, plugins, channels, and upgrade policy rather than one isolated implementation file.
